sch: Bulk historical import (analyst: Jim Totime). Source: AS newspaper 1989-90 La Liga season-preview page per club (scanned PDF) -- a PLANTILLA bio table (name, DOB+birthplace, height/weight, procedencia club+year, international caps, grouped by position) -- cross-matched against FBref's Standard/Misc/GK Stats exports for real 1989-90 season numbers (MP, Min, Gls, CrdY, CrdR; assists are not tracked for this season in FBref's own data). Both sources cover the same season (no lag, unlike the Portugal 1996-97 project). pos is the AS document's own section grouping, trusted over FBref's Pos tag where they differ for dual-role players. nat is FBref's own Nation column when matched there, else inferred from birthplace. Players listed in the plantilla with no FBref match played 0 minutes that season (mp/g/min/crdY = 0), not excluded. No career-total or contract-end data exists in this source.
